<MethodEndpoint
  method={"delete"}
  path={"/projects/{projectId}/agent-bindings/{agentSlug}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



DELETES the agent's binding — it does not copy the area's model into it. Copying would look the same on screen and is not: it would become a copy, and the area's next change would silently leave this agent behind. 404 when it already inherits.
